none: No client holds a grant in this realm. A grant is made by an authorization request carrying grant_management_action=create.
note: Grant Management for OAuth 2.0. A confidential client names what a person let it do — creating a grant, merging more into one or replacing it through ordinary authorization requests — and reads or revokes it at {path} with the grant_management_query and grant_management_revoke scopes. A grant exists once its tokens are claimed, and expires with the last of them.
